featured_reviews.name: Sanober Pardiwalla
featured_reviews.review_text:
On 24th September 2025, between 11:00am -11:10am my car tyre was completely damaged at Four Seasons Signature Residences after I drove over an exposed cement block with protruding iron rods positioned at a blind corner—on turning towards the basement parking— a hazard clearly visible on the property CCTV. While management acknowledged the danger and temporarily covered it with a cone, they refused any responsibility or compensation. The manager also dismissed the incident, stating it “wouldn’t have happened if our driver or another driver had been driving,” shifting blame onto me rather than addressing a serious safety failure.

This negligence is extremely unsafe for residents, visitors, and drivers. Four Seasons Signature Residences must inspect and permanently fix this hazard, improve visitor safety measures, and take responsibility for damage caused by hazards on their property. Such incidents and dismissive handling are unacceptable for a property of this reputation.

featured_reviews.name: Sajeev Francis
featured_reviews.review_text:
Royal Apartment CHS is an older construction, but it is reasonably maintained and managed. The property has stood the test of time and continues to provide a comfortable living environment for its residents. The management team does a commendable job in ensuring that the building remains in good condition, addressing any issues promptly and efficiently.

Despite its age, the building has a certain charm and character that newer constructions often lack. The common areas are kept clean, and the facilities are functional. The residents seem to have a sense of community, which adds to the overall positive atmosphere of the place.

One of the key strengths of Royal Apartment CHS is its location. Situated in a convenient area, it offers easy access to essential services, shops, and public transportation. This makes it an ideal choice for those who value convenience and accessibility.

While there may be some signs of wear and tear, the management's efforts to maintain the property are evident. Regular maintenance and timely repairs ensure that the building remains safe and habitable. The staff is responsive and attentive to the needs of the residents, which is a significant plus.

Overall, Royal Apartment CHS is a reliable and well-managed place to call home. It may not have the modern amenities of newer buildings, but it makes up for it with its charm, community spirit, and excellent management. If you're looking for a comfortable and well-maintained place to live, Royal Apartment CHS is worth considering.
